definition: Jenny Williams, the nine months in Nauvoo, and the letter that came late

settled:
After the study abroad I went back to Nauvoo for nine months to work for my grandfather. He invited me on a whim with three hours' notice, and thirty minutes later I was gone.

There I fell hard for a girl named Jenny Williams. We both held the same standard of no relationships before a mission, and I was about to leave, so we never went further than a few double dates and a lot of conversations. We never held hands and never kissed.

She told me the school she was planning to attend, and I made plans to join her there afterward.

I left on a mission at twenty. My companions all knew I was planning to go to school with Jenny Williams. The week before I went home I got a letter from her. She had changed her mind and was not going to be there. I had no other plans, so I went anyway.

title: The One I Planned My Life Around
